text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran a seqlen sweep comparing Llama-2-13B / Mistral-7B / Qwen-14B across us-west-2 (h100) and eu-central-1 (a100). noticed weird latency cliff for Qwen at >4k that looks like kernel fallback.
josh: can you paste the run config? batch sizes, quant, kernel flags?
maria: batch=1/4, seqlens [512,1024,2048,4096,8192], quant=INT8 (quant4 not applied yet), kernel_policy=auto. used the same container image in both regions.
kai: interesting — fallback usually happens when rope/GQA path isn't available for that seqlen -> falls back to generic attention which kills latency. did you capture p50/p99?
maria: yes — p50/p99 (ms) for Qwen-14B on h100/us-west-2: 512-> 38/72, 2048-> 82/160, 4096-> 210/480, 8192-> 540/1300. on a100/eu-central-1: 512-> 44/88, 2048-> 110/250, 4096-> 260/620, 8192-> 900/2300.
anika: those 8192 numbers are brutal on a100 — sounds like kernel mismatch + no long-seq optimized kernels. do we have kernel selection logs? perf-bot: CI perf run #2024 posted results: https://perf.example.com/runs/2024 (summary in thread).
josh: maria, can you paste stdout from runtime when the request hits fallback? should show "fallthrough kernel" or similar.
maria: pasted snippet: ```INFO runtime: model=qwen-14b kernel=rope_gqa not found for seqlen=8192, falling back to attention_generic_v2```. also saw increased memcpy time in traces.
kai: that confirms it. possible fixes: 1) enable kernel precompile for seqlen bucket (we have compile tool), 2) recommend switching to GQA-enabled model build for Qwen, 3) use ctx-slicing at request router to split into 4k chunks and stitch with KV.
anika: for throughput sizing — how many replicas to maintain for 99th SLO 1s at 8k? maria: on h100, single replica saturates ~6 rps at 8k with p99 ~1.3s; need 2 replicas for steady 10 rps. on a100 it's <3 rps per replica.
josh: can we instead route >=4k seq to Mistral-7B condensation mode (better long-seq kernel) as temporary fallback? tradeoffs in quality?
anmaria: (typo, corrected) anika: quality drop for some instruction-heavy prompts — did a small eval, ROUGE dropped ~2-3 points vs Qwen at 8k. but for retrieval-augmented generation it's fine.
kai: let's add an automated rollout rule: for requests >4096, route by policy: prefer models with long-seq optimized kernels (mistral_variant or llama_ctxscale). add a kernel precompile job for Qwen-14B seqlen buckets [4096,8192] in eu/us.
maria: created infra task: `/infra run-precompile --model qwen-14b --seq-buckets 4096,8192 --regions us-west-2,eu-central-1` (ran in staging). saw successful compile for rope_gqa_hybrid on h100 but a100 compile timed out once — need tweak. deploy-bot: precompile job queued in prod; ETA ~2h.
josh: also try quant4 compile path — quantization changes kernel selection sometimes and reduces memory pressure. would help throughput.
anmaria: noted, will run quant4 sweep next. for now updating routing table to avoid hitting generic fallback in prod.
perf-bot: summary: Qwen kernel fallthrough causes 3-4x p99 regression at seqlen>=4096 on a100; workaround: precompile GQA/rope kernels or route to Mistral/ctxscale. ticket: PERF-842. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
kai: thanks — assigned to infra+ml, keeping this thread for follow-ups.
